items.title: How an Unpolarized Light be Polarized? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: How an Unpolarized Light be Polarized?: a main subheading of 8.1 Polarization of light, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 174-176.

blocks.text: Unpolarized light ko in tareeqon se polarized kiya ja sakta hai:

items: Light ko polarizing filter (jaise polaroid sheet) se guzar kar.
Polarizing beam splitter istemal kar ke.
Kuch khaas optical crystals ya materials (jaise calcite, quartz) istemal kar ke.

blocks.text: Sab se aam tareeqa yeh hai ke unpolarized light ko polarizing filter (jaise polarizing beam splitter ya polaroid sheet) se guzara jaye. Filter se sirf woh electric field vector guzarta hai jo filter ke axis ke parallel ho; baqi sab ruk jate hain. Is tarah nikalne wali light polarized ho jati hai (Fig. 8.3).

blocks.alt: Ek shua (neeli lakeer) daen neeche ki taraf jati hai. Filter se pehle surkh E teer kai directions mein hain. Shua khari lakeeron aur khare axis teer wale polarized filter se guzarti hai. Filter ke baad sirf ek khara surkh E teer hai. Labels: E, Polarized filter, Axis, Polarization direction, Direction of ray.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.3: Polarized light ki direction (kitab ki Figure 8.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Saada alfaaz mein: unpolarized light ko polarized light mein badalne ka process polarization kehlata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Filter ka axis vertical hai, is liye E ka sirf woh hissa guzarta hai jo axis ke parallel hai. Baqi directions wale hisse ruk jate hain. Filter ke baad E sirf ek (vertical) direction mein hilta hai: yeh polarization direction hai, aur ray apni direction mein chalti rehti hai.

blocks.title: Basis of polarization (polarization ki bunyad)
blocks.text: Light waves ke electric field vector E ka kisi ek khaas direction mein hona hi polarization ki basis hai.

blocks.prompt: Polarization ki definition (tareef) karein. Light polarized ho sakti hai magar sound kyun nahi (MCQ 8.1; comprehensive question 8.1)?
blocks.explanation: Polarization light ki electric aur magnetic vibrations ko ek plane tak confine (mehdood) karna hai. Sirf transverse waves (jin ki vibration chalne ki direction ke perpendicular ho) ki vibration ka plane chuna ja sakta hai; light transverse hai, is liye polarized ho sakti hai. Sound longitudinal hai: us ki vibration chalne ki direction ke saath hai, is liye usay kisi plane tak confine nahi kiya ja sakta. MCQ 8.1 ka jawab (b) hai: light ka kisi khaas plane mein vibrate karna.

items: Interference aur diffraction batate hain ke light wave hai; polarization batati hai ke woh transverse hai. Plane of polarization = vibration ki direction + chalne ki direction wala plane.

Unpolarized light har plane mein vibrate karti hai (dhoop, bulb, mom batti); polarized sirf ek mein. Methods (tareeqe): polarizing filter (polaroid), polarizing beam splitter, crystals (calcite, quartz); filter sirf apne axis ke parallel E guzarta hai.
